title: galactia heterophylla
intro: Galactia heterophylla, commonly known as American milkpea or American milkpea vine, is a perennial flowering plant native to the southeastern United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, cough, and sore throat, making it a popular remedy for respiratory issues. The health benefits of Galactia heterophylla can be attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential therapeutic uses.
